refresh-interval.tooltip: How often the desklet re-fetches usage from the providers. There is also a Refresh button in the header.

time-range.tooltip: The look-back window shown on the cards.

desklet-width.tooltip: Width of the desklet in pixels. Cinnamon desklets are not drag-resizable; set a width here (default 420 for roomier cards).

claude-enabled.tooltip: Fetch usage for Claude. Plan logins show the 5-hour / 7-day plan meters; org admin keys show raw token usage.

claude-set-key.tooltip: Stores an Anthropic org admin API key (sk-ant-admin01-…) OR your Claude plan OAuth access token in the GNOME keyring. Plan logins show your real 5h/weekly usage.

claude-clear-key.tooltip: Deletes the stored Claude credential from the keyring.

codex-enabled.tooltip: Fetch usage for Codex. ChatGPT plan logins show the 5-hour / 7-day plan meters; org admin keys show raw token usage.

codex-set-key.tooltip: Stores an OpenAI org admin API key (sk-…) OR your ChatGPT plan OAuth access token (tokens.access_token from ~/.codex/auth.json) in the GNOME keyring.

codex-clear-key.tooltip: Deletes the stored Codex credential from the keyring.

ollama-enabled.tooltip: Fetch usage from https://ollama.com/api/usage (requests; tokens/cost on paid plans) and /api/balance (allowance %).

ollama-set-key.tooltip: Stores your ollama.com bearer key in the GNOME keyring.

ollama-clear-key.tooltip: Deletes the stored Ollama key from the keyring.
